diet.text: Mainly amphibians; also fish, lizards and rodents

overview.text: The Military Ground Snake is a water-loving snake of South America east of the Andes.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: South America east of the Andes, from the Guianas and Venezuela south to Paraguay, Uruguay and north-eastern Argentina.

habitat.text: Water and riverside habitats in lowland rainforest and Atlantic forest.

diet.text: Mainly amphibians and their eggs and tadpoles, plus fish, lizards and small rodents.
